NFL DFS Defense Rankings: Week 10 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 15 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 15, 2:21 PM ET

The Rams are the top-projected defense on the Week 10 DraftKings main slate at 8.8 DraftKings points for $3,800, at Arizona. Jaguars (7.7, $4,000) and Seahawks (7.5, $3,300) are next.

The Rams are also the top value at the position: 2.30 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 15, 2:21 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Defenses to know in Week 10

Rams, LAR at ARI ($3,800)

Rams carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 8.8 DraftKings points at $3,800. That is 1.0 points clear of Jaguars. The salary works out to 2.30 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 7 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Rams averaged 8.8 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 15.3, and it holds 6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 9.5-point favorite on the road against Arizona, with an implied team total of 24 in a game totaled at 38.5.

Value: Seahawks, SEA at LV ($3,300)

Seahawks projects for 7.5 DraftKings points at $3,300, which works out to 2.27 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 7 defenses the model projects for 6 or more points. Across 10,000 simulations Seahawks averaged 7.6 points with a simulated floor of -0.2 and a ceiling of 15.6, and it holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Seattle is a 6.5-point favorite on the road against Las Vegas, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 40.5.
